P7479.corridor_notes: Kunlun Energy Yunnan Xiangyun pipeline project (昆仑能源云南祥云管道项目), a 17 km branch off the China-Myanmar mainline running from Valve Station #17 in Shalong Town through to Xiangyun Terminal Station in Xiangcheng Town, both within Xiangyun County, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture — matches GEM's Start/EndLocation ('Xiangyun County' both ends) and Length (17.00 km exact). Built 2016-03 to 2019-06, commercial operation from 2019-10; serves ~480,000 residents of Xiangyun County. Design pressure 10 MPa, annual design capacity 100 million m3.
P7479.researcher_notes: Strong single-source match (Sohu republication of a China Energy Net operational feature); a second, near-identical republication of the same underlying company article exists at www.china5e.com/news/news-1071347-1.html and www.xny365.com/news/article-171349.html but these trace to the same original piece (not independent per the corroboration rule) — treated as one source. Length (17 km) and both county-level endpoints exactly match GEM's existing fields, giving high confidence despite single-source status.
